idea-plugin.name: Pulsing Highlights
idea-plugin.description:
Animated highlighting for problems: instead of a static underline, the problematic line slowly "breathes" with a translucent background, and a newly appeared problem flashes a few times before settling into the pulse.

Different colors per severity: errors are red, warnings are yellow, weak warnings are dark yellow. An optional colored frame around the editor shows the worst problem in the current file.

Error (red)


Warning (yellow)


Configure colors, opacity, period, warnings and the frame in Settings | Editor | Pulsing Highlights.

Works in any IntelliJ-based IDE (GoLand, IDEA, WebStorm, ...); the plugin only uses editor APIs and does not depend on a specific language plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.2.1
  • Fixed irregular flicker during the first second: the initial flash and the breathing pulse are now sequential phases and no longer overlap.
Version 0.2.0
  • Initial release.
  • Animated pulse for errors, warnings and weak warnings (separate colors).
  • Optional colored frame around the editor, based on the worst problem in the file.
  • Configurable colors, opacity, pulse period and flash-on-new-problem.
